description: The project will install 125 to 129 wind turbine generators within the lease area
geographic_scope: Lease Area OCS-A 0534 and potentially a portion of OCS-A 0501
context_quote: The Selected Alternative would allow for up to 130 foundations for the installation of 125 to 129 WTGs and 1 to 5 ESPs within Lease Area OCS-A 0534 and potentially a portion of OCS-A 0501 (collectively the Southern Wind Development Area [SWDA]) offshore Massachusetts.

description: The project will install 1 to 5 electrical service platforms within the lease area
geographic_scope: Lease Area OCS-A 0534 and potentially a portion of OCS-A 0501
context_quote: The Selected Alternative would allow for up to 130 foundations for the installation of 125 to 129 WTGs and 1 to 5 ESPs within Lease Area OCS-A 0534 and potentially a portion of OCS-A 0501 (collectively the Southern Wind Development Area [SWDA]) offshore Massachusetts.

description: The project will install up to 5 offshore export cables, with 2 cables for Phase 1 and up to 3 cables for Phase 2
context_quote: Five offshore electrical transmission cables, including two for Phase 1 and three for Phase 2, would be installed in an offshore export cable corridor (OECC).

description: The Phase 1 export cables will be installed in the Eastern OECC in Muskeget Channel
context_quote: For Phase 1, two cables would be installed in the Eastern OECC in Muskeget Channel.

description: The Phase 2 export cables may be installed in the Eastern OECC in Muskeget Channel, the Western Variant in Muskeget Channel, and/or the South Coast Variant
geographic_scope: Eastern OECC in Muskeget Channel, Western Variant in Muskeget Channel, and/or South Coast Variant
context_quote: For Phase 2, three cables would be installed in various proposed configurations in the Eastern OECC in Muskeget Channel, the Western Variant in Muskeget Channel and/or the South Coast Variant (SCV), which runs to the south and west of Martha's Vineyard, through Rhode Island Sound.

description: The Phase 1 export cables will make landfall in Barnstable County, Massachusetts
context_quote: Landing sites for Phase 1 cables would be in Barnstable County, Massachusetts.

description: The Phase 2 export cables will make landfall in Barnstable County, Massachusetts, with the possibility of a landing site in Bristol County
geographic_scope: Barnstable County, Massachusetts; Bristol County, Massachusetts
context_quote: Intended landing sites for Phase 2 cables would also be in Barnstable County, with the possibility of a landing site in Bristol County as well.

description: The South Coast Variant (SCV) export cable route is a contingency option that may be used for Phase 2 cables
geographic_scope: South of Martha's Vineyard, through Rhode Island Sound
context_quote: The SCV could include up to three offshore electrical transmission cables for Phase 2 only (in lieu of or in addition to the proposed route through Muskeget Channel) with a cable landing site, onshore transmission cable, grid interconnection, and new or upgraded substations in Bristol County, Massachusetts.

description: The minimum nameplate capacity of each wind turbine generator is 16 MW
context_quote: This equates to an approximate minimum nameplate capacity of 16 MW per WTG.

description: The project will generate at least 2,036 MW and up to 2,600 MW of electricity
context_quote: In total, both phases combined would include up to 132 total foundations for 125 to 129 WTGs and 1 to 5 ESPs to be installed in 130 positions, [9] generating at least 2,036 MW and up to 2,600 MW of electricity to meet existing and potential future offtake demands for New England states.

context_quote: In total, both phases combined would include up to 132 total foundations for 125 to 129 WTGs and 1 to 5 ESPs to be installed in 130 positions, [9] generating at least 2,036 MW and up to 2,600 MW of electricity to meet existing and potential future offtake demands for New England states.

description: The project will install the wind turbine generators and electrical service platforms in 130 positions within the lease area

context_quote: In total, both phases combined would include up to 132 total foundations for 125 to 129 WTGs and 1 to 5 ESPs to be installed in 130 positions, [9] generating at least 2,036 MW and up to 2,600 MW of electricity to meet existing and potential future offtake demands for New England states.

description: The wind turbine generators may be microsited up to 500 feet from their proposed locations to avoid seafloor hazards
geographic_scope: Within 500 feet of proposed WTG locations
context_quote: In accordance with 30 CFR § 585.634(c)(6), micrositing of WTG foundations may occur within 500 feet from each proposed WTG location. WTG micrositing would be performed on a case-by-case basis to avoid significant seafloor hazards such as surface and subsurface boulders (see COP Section 2.2.1.1).
